subject: Clarify decision roles, procurement gates, and acquisition timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-12T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify decision roles, procurement gates, and acquisition timeline

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for carving time out today. Quick recap from our side and a few concrete asks so we can map next steps clearly: 

- Recap: demo covered hosted vs dedicated vs private deployment options, expected latencies for your 3 use-cases, and the basic security controls you flagged (VPC, KMS, audit logs).
- Primary asks for us to build a tailored commercial + implementation plan:  
  1) Org chart or list of stakeholders who will review/approve (ECONOMY BUYER, Security, Legal, Procurement, Eng lead for rollout)
  2) Who is the economic buyer and the final signature authority?
  3) Security & privacy reviewers (names/email) and what evidence they need (SOC2, data retention map, encryption keys)
  4) Procurement contact and typical SOW/PO cadence + any necessary contracting templates
  5) Target decision timeline and go/no-go criteria (e.g., SLA, cost per 1k tokens, data residency)

I attached the demo deck again for easy sharing. If you can reply with an org sketch or a quick list this week, I’ll draft a proposed mutual action plan and who we should loop in at Redwood (legal, enterprise CS, solutions).

Thanks — talk soon.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0129
redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sabrina Li <sabrina.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-13T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify decision roles, procurement gates, and acquisition timeline

Jonas —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clean recap. Quick answers to start:  

- Economic buyer: Maria Duarte (VP Product) — maria.duarte@acmehealth.com (she’ll drive budget approval).
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com (I’ll introduce you to the lead once we scope pricing).
- Security reviewers: Sabrina Li (secops) will run the security checklist — sabrina.li@acmehealth.com; she asked for SOC 2 Type II, encryption-at-rest details, and audit-log retention policy.
- Decision timeline: hoping to lock vendor shortlist by end of November and a PO by mid-December; primary decision criteria are cost at scale, integration effort, and security evidence.

I’m attaching a rough org chart. It’s not 100% current but should help. Will introduce Maria and procurement lead in a follow-on thread when we have the draft commercial plan.

—Ethan
Product Lead, AcmeHealth
ethan.cole@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_org_chart_v2.pdf (200KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-13T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Clarify decision roles, procurement gates, and acquisition timeline

Marissa / Karthik —

Looping you in on the AcmeHealth thread. They provided a starter org sketch and named Maria (Economic buyer) + Sabrina (security reviewer). Timeline is aggressive: shortlist by EoM, PO mid-December.

Can you help with two things?
1) Marissa — can you prepare a topline commercial option set we can share (hosted API pilot pricing, dedicated reserved pool estimate, and a 6-month pilot bundle with support)? Include quick notes on any discounting guardrails for mid-market deals.
2) Karthik — can you pull the SOC2/crypto summary and a privacy/data-retention one-pager we can drop into the thread for Sabrina? If we have a standard security evidence packet link, include that.

I’ll hold off on the Maria/Procurement intro until we have the MAP and pilot pricing.

Thanks —
Jonas

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify decision roles, procurement gates, and acquisition timeline

Ethan —

Thanks for the quick responses and the chart — super helpful. I’m copying Karthik and our security lead into the thread (Karthik has the SOC2 artifacts and the short security factsheet).

Next practical step: Jonas and I will draft a mutual action plan that maps deliverables to owners and dates (pilot scope, success criteria, security evidence handoff, procurement milestones). Before we introduce Maria + procurement, can you confirm two things: 

1) Expected pilot success criteria — what does success look like at the end of 6 weeks? (usage targets, latency targets, or integration milestones)
2) Any mandatory contract terms (e.g., data residency, minimum term) that procurement will require in the SOW?

If you’re okay, Jonas will share the MAP and a three-option commercial sheet later today. Once we have that, Ethan — please do an intro to Maria + procurement@acmehealth.com so we can align the legal and procurement reviews.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0177
